descriptions.normal: A chicken dish native to Liyue. Prepared with simple spices, it strives to highlight the authentic flavor of fresh ingredients. The finished dish has smooth skin, tender meat, and a fresh taste, and is especially delightful when paired with a dipping sauce.
descriptions.suspicious: A chicken dish native to Liyue. Its skin is a tantalizing bright yellow, beautifully contrasting with the pale, tender-looking meat beneath. Yet the moment you take a bite, regret sets in — the meat is dry and tough, wedging itself stubbornly between your teeth...
descriptions.delicious: A chicken dish native to Liyue. The skin has a satisfying firmness, and the meat is tender and flavorful. The natural gelatin from the chicken, set into a jelly, brims with the rich aroma of rendered chicken fat, and even the bones carry a subtle hint of sweetness. This dish is a true symphony of flavors, certain to delight even the most discerning gourmand.
